## Side knowledge store.
By progressing as your main path, you gradually unlock more side knowledge to purchase. At the beginning you get access to tier 1 side knowledge and you can also select one of 3 random tier 1 side knowledge for free. Tier 1 and 2 side knowledge cost 1 point, and tier 3 cost 2 points. All side knowledge can either be purchased by either Main Points or Side Points. By collecting influences using codex get one extra Side Point.
## Heretic Knowledge
### Heartbeat of Mansus
Cost: 0
Tier: Roundstart
Ingredients/Type: Target's corpse
Sacrifice your target (or another heretic) for knowledge points.
### Phylactery of Damnation
Cost: 0
Tier: Roundstart
Ingredients/Type: Blood, Beaker
Creates a cursed beaker capable of stealing blood from a distance for curses.
### Feast of Owls
Cost: 0
Tier: Roundstart
Ingredients/Type: Your soul
Grants you five knowledge points, but locks you out of ascension.
### Codex Cicatrix
Cost: 0
Tier: Roundstart
Ingredients/Type: Book, Pen, organ or limb
Creates the Codex Cicatrix, a book used to harvest eldritch influences more effectively or to draw and clear transmutation runes. Also acts as a focus.
### Relentless Heartbeat
Cost: 0
Tier: Roundstart
Ingredients/Type: Heart, Book, Pen, Jumpsuit
Grants you a new set of ritual targets, up to five.
### Amber Focus
Cost: 0
Tier: Roundstart
Ingredients/Type: Glass sheet, Eyes
Grants you a focus that can be worn on the neck slot. Focuses let you cast advanced spells.
### Living Heart
Cost: 0
Tier: Roundstart
Ingredients/Type: Active Ability
Locates your sacrifice targets, but is loud. Be careful about when you use it.
### Cloak of Shadow
Cost: 0
Tier: Roundstart
Ingredients/Type: Active Ability
Hides your identity and makes you move faster, but your actions proceed slower. Can be removed by damage.
### Ether of the Newborn
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: Vomit puddle, Glass shard
Creates a single use potion that cures disease, wounds, and fully restores health, at the cost of a minute of sleep.
### Void Cloak
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: Bedsheet, Glass shard, Winter coat
Creates a weak armor that is invisible while the hood is up, and provides focus and space immunity while the hood is down.
### Ashen Eyes
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: Eyes, Glass shard, Flare
Creates an eldritch medallion that provides thermal vision and acts as a focus.
### Priest's Ritual
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: Glass shard, Water tank
Creates a flask of eldritch essence, a potent healing mixture for heretics.
### Scorching Shark
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: Three Ash, Liver, Three Plasma
Summons three fire sharks, fast but weak swarm monsters that ignite those who they bite and are resistant to fire.
### Realignment
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: Active Ability
Removes stuns, knockdowns, and restraints from you, as well as giving you resistance to stuns, temporarily makes you unable to attack.
### Mask of Madness
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: Mask, Stun Baton, Liver
Provides flash immunity and eye protection, instills great fear in heathens. Can be toggled to give night vision instead.
### Eldritch Coin
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: 1 Gold or 1 Silver
Toggles door bolts or opens/closes doors when flipped.
### Mysteries of Creation
Cost: 1
Tier: T1 Side
Ingredients/Type: Spear, cold temperature
Creates a glacial spear, a throwing weapon that shatters and freezes targets that it hits, can be freely recalled unless destroyed.
### Unfathomable Curio
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Utility belt, 3 Rods, Lungs
Provides a lot of storage space, focus and recharging shield.
### Carving Knife
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Knife, Glass shard, Paper
Creates a carving knife, a knife that allows you to etch traps that activate when a heathen walks over them.
### Codex Morbus
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Codex Cicatrix, Corpse
Creates a codex morbus, an upgraded and faster Codex Cicatrix that can draw runes faster and curse other crewmembers.
### Greaves of the Prophet
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Magboots, Combat boots, Two Silver bars
Creates a pair of armored greaves; shoes that act as no-slips, magboots, and jackboots.
### Mawed Crucible
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Table, Water tank
Creates a mawed crucible; a cauldron that can brew potions, but must be refilled with body parts or organs.
### Through the Boundary
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Two heretic blades, Two ID cards, and Two Bars of gold
Creates a ragged sword, a melee weapon that inflicts targets with random marks and hits from a long range.
### Rusted Ritual
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Pool of Vomit, 15 Cable coil, 5 Sheets of steel
Summons a rust walker, a creature that can spread rust and heals on it.
### Shattered Ritual
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Corpse, Latex gloves, Armor
Summons a shattered risen, a creature that has high health and regeneration, has two strong melee weapons, but cannot use items or clothes.
### Lionhunter's Rifle
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Wood plank, PDA, organ or limb
Creates a lionhunter's rifle, a weak ballistic gun that can be aimed at targets by right clicking them in Combat Mode, which causes projectile to be greatly empowered.
### Rust Sower Grenade
Cost: 1
Tier: T2 Side
Ingredients/Type: Grenade casing, rag, 2 trash
Creates an eldritch rust grenade that spread smoke, obliterating silicons and blinding organics caught in it.
### Crimson Cleave
Cost: 2
Tier: T3 Side
Ingredients/Type: Active Ability
Causes heavy bleeding to targets in a moderate area, heals you for every target.
### Forest Abomination
Cost: 2
Tier: T3 Side
Ingredients/Type: Active Ability
Upgrades most aspects of cloak of shadow, and spreads a disorienting fog wherever you go.
### Mind Grasp
Cost: 2
Tier: T3 Side
Ingredients/Type: Active Ability
Upgrades your Mansus grasp, it can now be channeled to effect everyone in a large area around you.
### Space Phase
Cost: 2
Tier: T3 Side
Ingredients/Type: Active Ability
A spell that allows you to move freely through space, can only be used outdoors in low pressure environments.
### Maid in the Mirror
Cost: 2
Tier: T3 Side
Ingredients/Type: Five Glass sheets, Jumpsuit, Lungs
Summons a maid in the mirror, a dangerous creature that can freeze targets it hits and go incorporeal.
### Sharp Medal
Cost: 2
Tier: T3 Side
Ingredients/Type: 2 hands, eyes, knife
Amulet that gives focus and allows you to throw your blades like boomerangs.
### Ashen Ritual
Cost: 2
Tier: T3 Side
Ingredients/Type: Bonfire, book
Summons ash spirit, a powerful summon with long range jaunt and deadly solar beam attack.
